anchors.statement: A phase plan too large for one sprint must be split into multiple sprints.
anchors.quote: If plan is too large it MUST be split.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: The plan split must place unrelated, non-intersecting work in separate sprints so the sprint dependency graph stays short.
anchors.quote: The split should be done to optimize horizontal waves (keep height of graph short), unrelated/un-intersecting work split into separate sprints.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: A large sprint of closely related work must be split into child beads under one dev, one child bead per background subagent.
anchors.quote: Large sprints w/ closely related work should be split into child beads one per [background] subagent.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance must recommend child beads for concentrated pockets of closely related work managed by a single dev agent.
anchors.quote: we are adding a new option which we want to highly recommend for efficiency.  It is important to create a well balanced plan of waves with concentrated pockets of work managed by a single dev agent
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: A child bead must declare its subagent's model with the existing beads class fast, normal or frontier.
anchors.quote: Use already defined 'fast','normal','frontier' classification in beads.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: The sprint's dev must run each child bead with a background subagent.
anchors.quote: I think it should be a strategy as part of planning to encourage agents to delegate work to multiple subagents (and specfically handle merging subagent work into their worktree)  when therre is a larger task.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Subagent work must not get its own PR; the sprint's dev must deliver one working, tested branch.
anchors.quote: We do not need pr for subagent work.  Primary dev agent is responsible for delivering a single working tested branch.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Each background subagent must run focused lint and tests on its own worktree.
anchors.quote: Additionally background sub-agents should do small focused test/lint on their worktree.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: The sprint's dev must delegate the full lint and test run to a background fast-class agent.
anchors.quote: Dev should delegate running full lint/test to background 'fast' agent.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: The dev's final rebase onto the top of the stack must happen after full lint and test pass.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: The dev must not rerun full lint and test after the final rebase unless the rebase required resolving conflicts in code the sprint wrote.
anchors.quote: Rebasing on top of stack AND make sure tests/lint pass 100% are impossible to both achieve if 5-15 minutes of testing are run after rebase. I have seen agents looping over run tests <-> rebase 10+ times in a row before they can land the stack. 4e could add 'unless conflicts with code written must be resolved' or similar.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: The dev task must state in a few words that the parent bead closes after its children, with enforcement left to the bd close failure and no hook or script.
anchors.quote: beads does NOT allow closing parent w/ open children.  This does NOT need much explaination, the agent will be told he can not close parent first so few words in task/prompt need to talk about it.  No hook/python for this at all outside of returning close fail message from failed 'bd close'.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Each sprint must have exactly one sanity bead, and it must name every dev bead of the sprint.
anchors.quote: There is ONE sanity bead for all dev work.  the sanity task/bead would specify all dev beads for split.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Every dev bead, parent and child, must record its git commit so sanity can match each commit to its bead.
anchors.quote: we should require git commit# per dev bead so sanity can coorelate commit to dev task/bead
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Each sprint must have exactly one QA bead and one QA run on the sprint's single worktree.
anchors.quote: Single qa bead, subagents would handle all work on single worktree as single qa run.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Docs, templates and prompts under atm-bd-orchestration must not mention plan-anchoring.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)

anchors.statement: Prompts and task text for the subtask strategy must contain only necessary words.
anchors.quote: in general prompts/tasks must be written with NO unnecessary words.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-11-07, issue atm-bd#937 subtask beads
anchors.scope: atm-bd-orchestration planning guidance, bead schema, dev/sanity/QA templates and hooks for subtask beads (#937)
